verdict.rationale: Anthropic's first-party docs cover a public API in depth: the Messages API, streaming, batches, tool use, token counting, model listing (GET /v1/models), Admin and Usage & Cost APIs, plus versioning guarantees, rate-limit semantics, official SDKs in seven languages, the `ant` CLI, and an llms.txt index that the probe confirmed. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API.
